subject.title: fix: allow bailian provider in resolveThinkingProfile

question: Should OpenClaw land a narrow custom `bailian` configured-provider inference fix now, or wait for the broader Qwen/Coding Plan provider-owned support decision?
rationale: The code path is source-reproducible, but enabling provider capability inference for existing custom Bailian configs is a product/provider-boundary decision and the broader canonical issue remains open.

options.title: Land Narrow After Cleanup And Proof
options.body: Require the vLLM policy removal, focused tests, and changed-path Bailian proof before treating this PR as a narrow custom-provider fix.

options.title: Defer To Canonical Qwen Work
options.body: Pause this PR and continue the bundled Coding Plan and custom-provider decisions through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/26037.

options.title: Accept Custom-Provider Risk
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally accept the default behavior change for existing custom `bailian` configs after documenting the support boundary.

recommendation.title: Land Narrow After Cleanup And Proof
recommendation.body: Require the vLLM policy removal, focused tests, and changed-path Bailian proof before treating this PR as a narrow custom-provider fix.
